# Install and load power analysis package
if (!require("pwr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pwr", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library("pwr")
}

# Parameters
mean_increase <- 0.2  # units
sd <- 0.5              # units
cohens_d <- mean_increase / sd  # Effect size
alpha <- 0.05          # Significance level (one-sided)
target_power <- 0.80   # Target power

cat("=== One-Sample t-Test Power Analysis ===\n")
cat("Mean increase (effect):", mean_increase, "units\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", cohens_d, "(small to medium)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "(one-sided)\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Use pwr.t.test for one-sample t-test
# type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater" for one-sided upper-tail test
result <- pwr.t.test(
  n = NULL,                    # Solve for n
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"      # One-sided upper-tail test
)

cat("Continuous solution (pwr::pwr.t.test):\n")
print(result)

# Extract and round up to minimum integer
n_continuous <- result$n
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("\n=== Sample Size Determination ===\n")
cat("Continuous solution: n =", n_continuous, "participants\n")
cat("Minimum integer sample size: n =", n_integer, "participants\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at n_integer
power_at_selected <- pwr.t.test(
  n = n_integer,
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = NULL,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"
)

cat("Verification at n =", n_integer, ":\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_at_selected$power, 6), "\n\n")

# Check power at preceding integer (n_integer - 1)
if (n_integer > 1) {
  power_preceding <- pwr.t.test(
    n = n_integer - 1,
    d = cohens_d,
    sig.level = alpha,
    power = NULL,
    type = "one.sample",
    alternative = "greater"
  )
  cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_integer - 1, "):\n")
  cat("Achieved power:", round(power_preceding$power, 6), "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No preceding design (n = 1 is minimum).\n\n")
}

# Summary for structured reporting
results_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_integer,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("=== Structured Results ===\n")
print(results_summary)

# Export as JSON for result marker
library("jsonlite")
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_integer, unit = "participants_total")
  ),
  simulation = NULL
)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")

# Independent verification of one-sample t-test power calculation
# Using multiple methods: pwr package, manual non-central t, and Monte Carlo simulation

library(jsonlite)

# ===== Parameters =====
mean_increase <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
cohens_d <- mean_increase / sd  # 0.4
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80

cat("=== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ===\n")
cat("Parameters:\n")
cat("  Mean effect: ", mean_increase, "\n")
cat("  SD: ", sd, "\n")
cat("  Cohen's d: ", cohens_d, "\n")
cat("  Alpha (one-sided): ", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power: ", target_power, "\n\n")

# ===== Method 1: pwr package (same as candidate) =====
library(pwr)
result_pwr <- pwr.t.test(
  n = NULL,
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"
)

cat("Method 1: pwr::pwr.t.test\n")
cat("  Continuous solution: n =", result_pwr$n, "\n")
cat("  Ceiling (minimum integer): n =", ceiling(result_pwr$n), "\n\n")

# ===== Method 2: Manual calculation using non-central t distribution =====
# For one-sample t-test: noncentrality parameter λ = d * sqrt(n)
# Power = P(t_{n-1}(λ) > t_{α, n-1})
# where t_{α, n-1} is the critical value

# We solve for n iteratively
find_n_by_nct <- function(d, alpha, target_power, alternative = "greater") {
  # Solve for n using noncentrality approach
  f <- function(n) {
    if (n < 1) return(NA)
    lambda <- d * sqrt(n)
    df <- n - 1
    
    if (alternative == "greater") {
      t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
      power <- pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else if (alternative == "two.sided") {
      t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df)
      power <- pt(-t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda) + pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else {
      stop("Unknown alternative")
    }
    return(power)
  }
  
  # Binary search for minimum n
  n_low <- 1
  n_high <- 1000
  
  while (n_high - n_low > 0.001) {
    n_mid <- (n_low + n_high) / 2
    power_mid <- f(n_mid)
    if (power_mid < target_power) {
      n_low <- n_mid
    } else {
      n_high <- n_mid
    }
  }
  
  return(n_high)
}

n_continuous_manual <- find_n_by_nct(cohens_d, alpha, target_power, alternative = "greater")
n_integer_manual <- ceiling(n_continuous_manual)

cat("Method 2: Manual non-central t distribution\n")
cat("  Continuous solution: n =", n_continuous_manual, "\n")
cat("  Ceiling (minimum integer): n =", n_integer_manual, "\n\n")

# ===== Verification: Compute power at n=40, 41, 42 =====
cat("=== Power Verification at Integer Sample Sizes ===\n")

for (n_test in c(39, 40, 41, 42)) {
  lambda <- cohens_d * sqrt(n_test)
  df <- n_test - 1
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
  power_achieved <- pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  # Also verify with pwr package
  pwr_check <- pwr.t.test(
    n = n_test,
    d = cohens_d,
    sig.level = alpha,
    type = "one.sample",
    alternative = "greater"
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("n = %d: power = %.6f (manual), %.6f (pwr)\n",
              n_test, power_achieved, pwr_check$power))
}

cat("\n=== Monte Carlo Simulation Check ===\n")

# Simulate the one-sample t-test for selected sample sizes
set.seed(42)
n_sims <- 10000

for (n_test in c(40, 41)) {
  # Generate data under alternative (true mean = 0.2, SD = 0.5)
  t_stats <- numeric(n_sims)
  for (i in 1:n_sims) {
    x <- rnorm(n_test, mean = mean_increase, sd = sd)
    t_stats[i] <- t.test(x, alternative = "greater")$statistic
  }
  
  # Critical value for one-sided test at α = 0.05
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = n_test - 1)
  
  # Power = proportion rejecting H0
  power_sim <- mean(t_stats > t_crit)
  mc_se <- sqrt(power_sim * (1 - power_sim) / n_sims)
  
  cat(sprintf("n = %d: simulated power = %.6f ± %.6f (10,000 replications)\n",
              n_test, power_sim, 1.96 * mc_se))
}

cat("\n=== Summary and Candidate Check ===\n")
cat("Candidate answer: n = 41\n")
cat("Continuous solution (pwr): n =", result_pwr$n, "\n")
cat("Minimum integer: n =", ceiling(result_pwr$n), "\n")
cat("Matches candidate:", ceiling(result_pwr$n) == 41, "\n")

# Final verification
power_at_41 <- pwr.t.test(n = 41, d = cohens_d, sig.level = alpha, 
                          type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater")$power
power_at_40 <- pwr.t.test(n = 40, d = cohens_d, sig.level = alpha, 
                          type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater")$power

cat("\nPower at n=41:", round(power_at_41, 6), "\n")
cat("Power at n=40:", round(power_at_40, 6), "\n")
cat("Does n=41 exceed target (0.80)?", power_at_41 >= target_power, "\n")
cat("Does n=40 fall below target (0.80)?", power_at_40 < target_power, "\n")

POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "verification_sample_size", value = 41, unit = "participants_total"),
    list(metric = "power_at_n41", value = round(power_at_41, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_n40", value = round(power_at_40, 6), unit = "proportion")
  ),
  simulation = list(
    seed = 42,
    trials = 10000,
    method = "one_sample_t_monte_carlo"
  )
)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")

plan.estimand: Mean increase of 0.2 units in a normally distributed outcome
plan.hypothesis: H₀: μ = 0 vs H₁: μ > 0 (or baseline difference = 0.2)
assumptions: One-sided test with rejection in upper tail
scientific_notes: Effect size (Cohen's d) = mean_increase / SD = 0.2 / 0.5 = 0.4 (small to medium effect)
One-sample t-test accounts for estimation of SD; power calculation uses non-central t distribution
Continuous solution will be rounded up to minimum integer satisfying target power

# Install and load power analysis package
if (!require("pwr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pwr", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library("pwr")
}

# Parameters
mean_increase <- 0.2  # units
sd <- 0.5              # units
cohens_d <- mean_increase / sd  # Effect size
alpha <- 0.05          # Significance level (one-sided)
target_power <- 0.80   # Target power

cat("=== One-Sample t-Test Power Analysis ===\n")
cat("Mean increase (effect):", mean_increase, "units\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", cohens_d, "(small to medium)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "(one-sided)\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Use pwr.t.test for one-sample t-test
# type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater" for one-sided upper-tail test
result <- pwr.t.test(
  n = NULL,                    # Solve for n
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"      # One-sided upper-tail test
)

cat("Continuous solution (pwr::pwr.t.test):\n")
print(result)

# Extract and round up to minimum integer
n_continuous <- result$n
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("\n=== Sample Size Determination ===\n")
cat("Continuous solution: n =", n_continuous, "participants\n")
cat("Minimum integer sample size: n =", n_integer, "participants\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at n_integer
power_at_selected <- pwr.t.test(
  n = n_integer,
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = NULL,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"
)

cat("Verification at n =", n_integer, ":\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_at_selected$power, 6), "\n\n")

# Check power at preceding integer (n_integer - 1)
if (n_integer > 1) {
  power_preceding <- pwr.t.test(
    n = n_integer - 1,
    d = cohens_d,
    sig.level = alpha,
    power = NULL,
    type = "one.sample",
    alternative = "greater"
  )
  cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_integer - 1, "):\n")
  cat("Achieved power:", round(power_preceding$power, 6), "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No preceding design (n = 1 is minimum).\n\n")
}

# Summary for structured reporting
results_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_integer,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("=== Structured Results ===\n")
print(results_summary)

# Export as JSON for result marker
library("jsonlite")
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_integer, unit = "participants_total")
  ),
  simulation = NULL
)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")

# Independent verification of one-sample t-test power calculation
# Using multiple methods: pwr package, manual non-central t, and Monte Carlo simulation

library(jsonlite)

# ===== Parameters =====
mean_increase <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
cohens_d <- mean_increase / sd  # 0.4
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80

cat("=== INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION ===\n")
cat("Parameters:\n")
cat("  Mean effect: ", mean_increase, "\n")
cat("  SD: ", sd, "\n")
cat("  Cohen's d: ", cohens_d, "\n")
cat("  Alpha (one-sided): ", alpha, "\n")
cat("  Target power: ", target_power, "\n\n")

# ===== Method 1: pwr package (same as candidate) =====
library(pwr)
result_pwr <- pwr.t.test(
  n = NULL,
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"
)

cat("Method 1: pwr::pwr.t.test\n")
cat("  Continuous solution: n =", result_pwr$n, "\n")
cat("  Ceiling (minimum integer): n =", ceiling(result_pwr$n), "\n\n")

# ===== Method 2: Manual calculation using non-central t distribution =====
# For one-sample t-test: noncentrality parameter λ = d * sqrt(n)
# Power = P(t_{n-1}(λ) > t_{α, n-1})
# where t_{α, n-1} is the critical value

# We solve for n iteratively
find_n_by_nct <- function(d, alpha, target_power, alternative = "greater") {
  # Solve for n using noncentrality approach
  f <- function(n) {
    if (n < 1) return(NA)
    lambda <- d * sqrt(n)
    df <- n - 1
    
    if (alternative == "greater") {
      t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
      power <- pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else if (alternative == "two.sided") {
      t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df)
      power <- pt(-t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda) + pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
    } else {
      stop("Unknown alternative")
    }
    return(power)
  }
  
  # Binary search for minimum n
  n_low <- 1
  n_high <- 1000
  
  while (n_high - n_low > 0.001) {
    n_mid <- (n_low + n_high) / 2
    power_mid <- f(n_mid)
    if (power_mid < target_power) {
      n_low <- n_mid
    } else {
      n_high <- n_mid
    }
  }
  
  return(n_high)
}

n_continuous_manual <- find_n_by_nct(cohens_d, alpha, target_power, alternative = "greater")
n_integer_manual <- ceiling(n_continuous_manual)

cat("Method 2: Manual non-central t distribution\n")
cat("  Continuous solution: n =", n_continuous_manual, "\n")
cat("  Ceiling (minimum integer): n =", n_integer_manual, "\n\n")

# ===== Verification: Compute power at n=40, 41, 42 =====
cat("=== Power Verification at Integer Sample Sizes ===\n")

for (n_test in c(39, 40, 41, 42)) {
  lambda <- cohens_d * sqrt(n_test)
  df <- n_test - 1
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
  power_achieved <- pt(t_crit, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  # Also verify with pwr package
  pwr_check <- pwr.t.test(
    n = n_test,
    d = cohens_d,
    sig.level = alpha,
    type = "one.sample",
    alternative = "greater"
  )
  
  cat(sprintf("n = %d: power = %.6f (manual), %.6f (pwr)\n",
              n_test, power_achieved, pwr_check$power))
}

cat("\n=== Monte Carlo Simulation Check ===\n")

# Simulate the one-sample t-test for selected sample sizes
set.seed(42)
n_sims <- 10000

for (n_test in c(40, 41)) {
  # Generate data under alternative (true mean = 0.2, SD = 0.5)
  t_stats <- numeric(n_sims)
  for (i in 1:n_sims) {
    x <- rnorm(n_test, mean = mean_increase, sd = sd)
    t_stats[i] <- t.test(x, alternative = "greater")$statistic
  }
  
  # Critical value for one-sided test at α = 0.05
  t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df = n_test - 1)
  
  # Power = proportion rejecting H0
  power_sim <- mean(t_stats > t_crit)
  mc_se <- sqrt(power_sim * (1 - power_sim) / n_sims)
  
  cat(sprintf("n = %d: simulated power = %.6f ± %.6f (10,000 replications)\n",
              n_test, power_sim, 1.96 * mc_se))
}

cat("\n=== Summary and Candidate Check ===\n")
cat("Candidate answer: n = 41\n")
cat("Continuous solution (pwr): n =", result_pwr$n, "\n")
cat("Minimum integer: n =", ceiling(result_pwr$n), "\n")
cat("Matches candidate:", ceiling(result_pwr$n) == 41, "\n")

# Final verification
power_at_41 <- pwr.t.test(n = 41, d = cohens_d, sig.level = alpha, 
                          type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater")$power
power_at_40 <- pwr.t.test(n = 40, d = cohens_d, sig.level = alpha, 
                          type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater")$power

cat("\nPower at n=41:", round(power_at_41, 6), "\n")
cat("Power at n=40:", round(power_at_40, 6), "\n")
cat("Does n=41 exceed target (0.80)?", power_at_41 >= target_power, "\n")
cat("Does n=40 fall below target (0.80)?", power_at_40 < target_power, "\n")

POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "verification_sample_size", value = 41, unit = "participants_total"),
    list(metric = "power_at_n41", value = round(power_at_41, 6), unit = "proportion"),
    list(metric = "power_at_n40", value = round(power_at_40, 6), unit = "proportion")
  ),
  simulation = list(
    seed = 42,
    trials = 10000,
    method = "one_sample_t_monte_carlo"
  )
)
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n", sep = "")

cat("Critical value (upper tail, α=0.05, df=40):", t_crit_upper, "\n")

# Under the alternative (true mean = 0.2, SD = 0.5)
lambda <- cohens_d * sqrt(n_test)
cat("Noncentrality parameter λ = d√n =", cohens_d, "×", sqrt(n_test), "=", lambda, "\n")

# Power is the probability of t > t_crit under the alternative
power_upper <- pt(t_crit_upper, df = df, ncp = lambda, lower.tail = FALSE)
cat("Power (upper tail) = P(t > ", t_crit_upper, " | H1) =", power_upper, "\n\n")

# Compare with two-sided test for completeness (not what was requested)

# Evidence e1; success=true

# Install and load power analysis package
if (!require("pwr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pwr", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library("pwr")
}

# Parameters
mean_increase <- 0.2  # units
sd <- 0.5              # units
cohens_d <- mean_increase / sd  # Effect size
alpha <- 0.05          # Significance level (one-sided)
target_power <- 0.80   # Target power

cat("=== One-Sample t-Test Power Analysis ===\n")
cat("Mean increase (effect):", mean_increase, "units\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", sd, "units\n")
cat("Cohen's d:", cohens_d, "(small to medium)\n")
cat("Significance level (α):", alpha, "(one-sided)\n")
cat("Target power:", target_power, "\n\n")

# Use pwr.t.test for one-sample t-test
# type = "one.sample", alternative = "greater" for one-sided upper-tail test
result <- pwr.t.test(
  n = NULL,                    # Solve for n
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = target_power,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"      # One-sided upper-tail test
)

cat("Continuous solution (pwr::pwr.t.test):\n")
print(result)

# Extract and round up to minimum integer
n_continuous <- result$n
n_integer <- ceiling(n_continuous)

cat("\n=== Sample Size Determination ===\n")
cat("Continuous solution: n =", n_continuous, "participants\n")
cat("Minimum integer sample size: n =", n_integer, "participants\n\n")

# Verify achieved power at n_integer
power_at_selected <- pwr.t.test(
  n = n_integer,
  d = cohens_d,
  sig.level = alpha,
  power = NULL,
  type = "one.sample",
  alternative = "greater"
)

cat("Verification at n =", n_integer, ":\n")
cat("Achieved power:", round(power_at_selected$power, 6), "\n\n")

# Check power at preceding integer (n_integer - 1)
if (n_integer > 1) {
  power_preceding <- pwr.t.test(
    n = n_integer - 1,
    d = cohens_d,
    sig.level = alpha,
    power = NULL,
    type = "one.sample",
    alternative = "greater"
  )
  cat("Power at preceding design (n =", n_integer - 1, "):\n")
  cat("Achieved power:", round(power_preceding$power, 6), "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No preceding design (n = 1 is minimum).\n\n")
}

# Summary for structured reporting
results_summary <- data.frame(
  metric = "sample_size",
  value = n_integer,
  unit = "participants_total"
)

cat("=== Structured Results ===\n")
print(results_summary)

# Export as JSON for result marker
library("jsonlite")
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_integer, unit = "participants_total")
  ),
  simulation = NULL
)
